subject: math

hotspots.label: Negative numbers
hotspots.description: Negative numbers sit left of zero — −5, −4, −3... and represent amounts below zero.
hotspots.positionHint: The left half of the number line, frost-tinted, labeled −1 through −5.

hotspots.label: Zero boundary
hotspots.description: Zero is the dividing point — positives lie right, negatives left, and any negative is less than zero.
hotspots.positionHint: The central, taller mark on the line.

hotspots.label: Adding a negative
hotspots.description: Adding a negative moves LEFT along the line — from −3, adding −2 lands on −5.
hotspots.positionHint: The leftward arrow with a '−2' label stepping along the line.
hotspots.function: Shows how adding a negative moves the value left.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A number line from −5 to 5 with a frost-tinted negative half, a thermometer-style marker, and a stepping arrow. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (grid-blue / amber / coral from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Number line: ink-grey cylinder with warm paper number plates (roughness ~0.5). Negative half: faint cool blue-grey tint on the left tile plates. Thermometer marker: thin glass-look tube (clear matte, roughness ~0.15) with a mercury-like amber column that fills up or down to the marker. Addition arrow: warm coral arrow. No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: negative numbers on a number line with a thermometer marker and left/right stepping arrows.

GEOMETRY: Number line: thin cylinder along x (length ~3.3) with tick marks and number plates −5..5. Zero mark taller. Negative half tiles (left side) get a faint cool tint. Thermometer marker: a tall thin tube at the marker position whose mercury column moves with the value (below zero reads into the frost zone). Step arrows: an amber 'left by n' arrow for adding negatives and a coral 'right by n' arrow for subtracting negatives.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) line + plates; (2) thermometer marker; (3) stepping arrows + result plate.

CAMERA: head-on from +z frames the full −5..5 line with the thermometer above; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: NumberLine, Ticks, NumberPlates, Thermometer_Tube, Mercury_Column, StepArrowLeft, StepArrowRight, ResultPlate. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
